paragraphs.text: You have, I think, been led to impose a contribution of mares on these people by false information on the part of the inhabitants. What is going on is quite unfair. It cannot but be displeasing to your excellency, and is distressing to me on account of my intimate connection with the victims of the wrong. I have therefore lost no time in begging your Lordship not to allow these promoters of iniquity to succeed in their malevolence.

latex.p0004: 我想，是当地居民提供的不实信息，导致您向这些人征收了母马税。此事极不公平，必然令阁下不悦，也因我与受害者的密切关系而感到痛心。因此，我立即恳求阁下，切勿让这些不义之徒的恶谋得逞。
